Time zones in the new-event form now work the way HEY's own form does.

![OmaCal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.0.5/preview.png)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88d5ff29-20e9-4e64-958d-b75dc3dade17

## Changed

- **Zones sit under their times, behind a globe.** 1.0.4 put a start zone and an end zone on rows of their own, always showing. As in HEY, the form now shows just the times and a globe. Click the globe, or press `Alt+Z`, and each time gets its zone underneath, shown as a city (Berlin). Type over a city to pick another zone (`new york`, `tokyo`), with `↑` `↓` to choose among the matches. The end's zone follows the start's until you give it its own. Hiding the zones again puts both times back on local time, so a hidden zone is never what gets sent.

| Zones hidden | Zones shown |
| --- | --- |
| ![The quick-add card with the globe next to the times](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.0.5/screenshots/quick-add.png) | ![The quick-add card with Berlin under the start and New York under the end](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f89afb65-180d-4e3e-9851-77069cc28cfa) |

## Known limitations

- **HEY shows an end with its own zone on the start's clock.** `hey event add` takes one time zone for both ends, so OmaCal saves the end at the right moment, converted to the start's zone. A flight from Berlin at 10:00 to New York at 13:00 is stored correctly, but HEY shows its end as 19:00 Berlin time.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omacal.git --enable
omarchy plugin disable omarchy.clock
```

Already installed: `omarchy plugin update crmne.omacal`.

OmaCal is an independent project, not created by, affiliated with, or supported by HEY or 37signals.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/omacal/compare/v1.0.4...v1.0.5
